title: Missing Old Logits in Asynchronous Agentic RL: Semantic Mismatch and Repair Methods for Off-Policy Correction
abstract: arXiv:2605.12070v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning improves rollout throughput for large language model agents by decoupling sample generation from policy optimization, but it also introduces a critical failure mode for PPO-style off-policy correction. In heterogeneous training systems, the total importance ratio should ideally be decomposed into two semantically distinct factors: a \emph{training--inference discrepancy term} that aligns inference-side and training-side distributions at the same behavior-policy version, and a \emph{policy-staleness term} that constrains the update from the historical policy to the current policy. We show that practical asynchronous pipelines with delayed updates and partial rollouts often lose the required historical training-side logits, or old logits. translated_title: 异步智能体强化学习中缺失的旧Logits：离策略校正的语义失配与修复方法
translated_abstract: 异步强化学习通过将样本生成与策略优化解耦，提升了大语言模型智能体的rollout吞吐量，但它也给PPO式的离策略校正引入了一个关键的失败模式。在异构训练系统中，总的重要性比率理想上应当被分解为两个语义上截然不同的因子：一个是“训练—推理差异项”，用于在相同行为策略版本下对齐推理侧与训练侧的分布；另一个是“策略陈旧项”，用于约束从历史策略到当前策略的更新。我们证明了，在实际采用延迟更新和部分rollout的异步流水线中，所需的历史训练侧logits（即旧logits）常常会丢失。这一“旧logits缺失”问题使得差异修复与陈旧性校正相互纠缠，破坏了解耦校正所预期的语义，并使裁剪机制……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了异步智能体强化学习中因历史训练侧旧logits缺失而导致的离策略校正语义失配问题，将重要性比率解耦为训练—推理差异项与策略陈旧项，并提出了相应的修复方法。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the missing-old-logit problem in asynchronous agentic RL, which entangles training-inference discrepancy repair with policy staleness correction, and proposes semantic-aware repair methods for PPO-style off-policy correction.
